name: Coccyx
features: Three to five fused rudimentary vertebrae
Attachment for the anococcygeal ligament and gluteus maximus
clinical: Coccydynia (tailbone pain) often follows a fall onto the buttocks.
modelNote: In the male model the coccyx is an approximate shape: BodyParts3D has no coccyx mesh. The female model uses a real scan.
sexDifferences: Female coccyx: usually more mobile and set more posteriorly, enlarging the pelvic outlet.
